frozen_test.transform: Deterministic variable bijection and polarity flips, clause/literal shuffling, plus exact 0,5,30 percent syntactically tautological CNF padding. Source and generated full SAT models replayed before child solver and every SAT response.

original_outcomes.lights_out_same_VM_paired_wall_ratio_whe: ~8-10x native on these sign/permutation-transformed variants, not equivalent to earlier 004E4 ratio ~20x; never merge populations or report universal speedup
original_outcomes.scientific_finding: The 80% denominator includes irrelevant tautological clauses; it can silently change which representation JANUS selects even when the logical SAT instance is exactly equivalent and the full previous parity decomposition remains available.

scientific_limit: Artificial tautology padding and variable renaming were selected to probe a hypothesis and are not independently curated unseen SAT instances or representative of SAT Competition distributions.
Different candidate algorithms on separate ephemeral GitHub runners cannot establish a global champion by raw wall-time across VMs. CPU-censored baselines cannot enter finite speed ratios.
On binary-tree variant+pad, direct native finishes, while adaptive times out; indicates a selector weakness, not wrong SAT correctness or general complexity separation.

Even if corrected policy excludes tautologies, evaluating that new policy on these same six generated formulas is development only, not unbiased validation. Freeze and test different source/transform families before any promotion.
Original main and C023 stay unchanged; external 004C Witness remains OPEN, P=NP not proven.
